tagline: Video calls where you hear their real voice and read them in your language.
permissionNote: Your browser will ask for your camera and microphone. They hear your real voice; captions appear on their screen.
shareTitle: Send this link to the person you're calling
waiting: Waiting for the other person to join…
cantConnectHint: Check that you both have a working internet connection, then try again.
peerLeft: The other person left the call.
roomGone: This call link has expired or doesn't exist.
roomFull: This call already has two people in it.
replaced: This call was opened in another tab or device.
inAppBody: Video calls can't use your camera and microphone inside this app.
inAppStepsIos: Tap the ••• or share button and choose “Open in Safari”, or copy the link and paste it into Safari.
inAppStepsAndroid: Tap the ⋮ menu and choose “Open in Chrome”, or copy the link and paste it into Chrome.
deniedIos: Tap “aA” in the address bar, then Website Settings, and set Camera and Microphone to Allow. If they are not listed, open Settings › Apps › Safari › Camera and Microphone and choose Ask or Allow. Then come back and reload.
deniedAndroid: Tap the icon to the left of the address bar, then Permissions, and allow Camera and Microphone. Then reload.
deniedDesktop: Click the camera icon in the address bar, allow camera and microphone for this site, then reload.
noMic: No microphone was found. Connect one and try again.
mediaError: Couldn't start your camera or microphone. Close other apps that might be using them and try again.
unsupported: This browser can't make video calls. Please use Safari or Chrome.
captionsUnavailable: Captions are unavailable right now. You can still talk.
installIos: To install, tap Share and then “Add to Home Screen”.
audioOnlyHint: Audio only uses much less data, so it's best on a weak connection. Captions still work.
captionsCheck: Captions are working: this is what they read when you speak.
weakNetwork: Your connection is weak. Switch to audio only to keep talking smoothly. Captions keep working.
theyCantSeeYou: The other person can't see your video. Restarting your camera…
theyCantHearYou: The other person can't hear you. Reconnecting your microphone…
cameraFailed: Your camera couldn't start. You can keep talking with audio and captions.
youAreAudioOnly: Audio only. Captions are still on.
theyAreAudioOnly: They switched to audio only to save data. Your video is paused for them.
videoNotArriving: Their video isn't coming through. Audio and captions still work.
consent: By joining, you agree that what you say is sent to our caption providers to make captions. Calls are never recorded.
